subtitle: Phone detox habit builder
promotionalText: Put your phone down, and your Blip lives an amazing year. Every day under your screen time goal grows a happier, healthier life.
description:
Take back your screen time, one day at a time.

Blip turns your daily screen time goal into a tiny life you care about. Pick a goal, and every day you stay under it, your Blip lives a great year: friends, adventures, a first car, a dream home. Go over, and they have a rough one.

ONE DAY FOR YOU. ONE YEAR FOR THEM.
• Set your own daily screen time goal.
• Each morning, yesterday's screen time decides your Blip's next year.
• Watch them grow from baby to grandparent, then play on as their kid.

AUTOMATIC, PRIVATE, AND FREE
• Connect iPhone Screen Time and Blip reads your daily total for you, or type it in yourself.
• Blip only gets one number a day, rounded to 15 minutes. It never sees which apps you use.
• Your screen time never leaves your phone. Automatic tracking is free, always.

SEE WHAT YOU GAINED
• Time back adds up every hour you didn't spend on your phone.
• Streaks, trophies and life milestones reward good days.
• A gentle morning reminder, only if you want one.

MAKE THEM YOURS
• Dress your Blip with hats, outfits and accessories, and spoil the family dog.
• Gifts are just for looks. They never change your Blip's life or your goal.
• Every gift is an heirloom that passes to the next generation.

Blip is a game to help you build better phone habits. It isn't medical advice or treatment.

reviewNotes:
Blip helps the user manage their own screen time. To test:
1. Open Blip, finish setup (Boy or Girl, name, goal).
2. Automatic screen time: Settings > Automatic screen time > Connect Screen Time. Uses Family Controls individual authorization and a DeviceActivity monitor only (15-minute thresholds). No app blocking. Data stays on device. Manual entry works if permission is declined. Automatic tracking is free, and the shop is never shown based on screen time results.
3. Each morning (after 4 AM) the check-in lives a year for yesterday's full day. On the first day there is no stored number yet, so the player types yesterday's total. Screen Time numbers appear the morning after real phone use; on a fresh install the first check-in uses manual entry.
4. Shop: Shop tab. Style items (bow, tiara, dresses, Style starter set) appear in Shop > Style when the Blip is a girl (choose Girl at setup). Baby clothes appear in Shop > Baby while the Blip is a baby (ages 0-4). Owned items stay in the Closet and any grown Blip can wear them. All purchases are cosmetic, non-consumable, and restorable (Shop > Restore purchases).
